title: Substrate recognition by human separase.
authors: Yu, Jun; Schmidt, Sophia; Botto, Margherita; Lee, Kitaik; Ghent, Chloe M; Goodfried, Jonah M; Howe, Andrew; O'Reilly, Francis J; Morgan, David O; Boland, Andreas
one_liner_zh: 该文通过冷冻电镜和交联质谱解析人源分离酶与底物SCC1的识别与切割机制，属于蛋白质-蛋白质互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题TF-DNA结合建模关联甚微。
abstract: The cohesin complex encircles sister chromatids in early mitosis. At anaphase onset, sister separation is triggered by the proteolytic cleavage of the cohesin subunit SCC1/RAD21 by separase. SCC1 contains two cleavage sites, where cleavage is stimulated by SCC1 phosphorylation. Substrate recognition and cleavage are only partly understood. Here, we determined structures of human separase in apo- or substrate-bound forms that, together with biochemical analysis, provide critical insights into separase cleavage regulation. We verify the first SCC1 cleavage site and reassign the second. We show that substrates, including separase autocleavage sites and the two SCC1 cleavage sites, interact with docking sites in separase, including five phosphate-binding sites. We also describe the interaction between the cohesin subunit SA1/SA2 and separase, which promotes cleavage at the second SCC1 site. Using cross-linking mass spectrometry and cryo-electron microscopy, we propose how cohesin is targeted by human separase. Our work provides an extensive functional and structural framework that explains a key event in cell division.
abstract_zh: 黏连蛋白复合体在早期有丝分裂中环绕姐妹染色单体。在后期起始时，姐妹染色单体的分离由分离酶对黏连蛋白亚基SCC1/RAD21的蛋白水解切割触发。SCC1包含两个切割位点，其切割受SCC1磷酸化刺激。底物识别和切割机制仅部分被理解。在此，我们确定了人类分离酶在无配体或底物结合形式下的结构，结合生化分析，为分离酶切割调控提供了关键见解。我们验证了第一个SCC1切割位点，并重新指定了第二个。我们展示了底物，包括分离酶自切割位点和两个SCC1切割位点，与分离酶中的对接位点相互作用，其中包括五个磷酸结合位点。我们还描述了黏连蛋白亚基SA1/SA2与分离酶之间的相互作用，该作用促进第二个SCC1位点的切割。利用交联质谱和冷冻电子显微镜，我们提出了人类分离酶如何靶向黏连蛋白的模型。我们的工作提供了一个广泛的功能和结构框架，解释了细胞分裂中的一个关键事件。
